_notes: Free-tier and pricing facts gathered from public docs / pricing pages via WebSearch/WebFetch on 2026-09-12.
Quotas and plans change; re-check provider docs before production wiring.
paid_required=false means a usable free/public path exists for prototyping; production may still need paid plans.

live_scores.name: ESPN site API (undocumented public)
live_scores.free_tier: No API key; widely used public JSON endpoints (scoreboard, summary, teams). Undocumented — no SLA.
live_scores.notes: Common patterns: /scoreboard, /scoreboard?dates=YYYYMMDD, week/seasontype/year params. Community catalogs (e.g. Public-ESPN-API gists). CAUTION: undocumented, may break or violate ESPN ToS for commercial redistrib — use only for prototypes or with legal review.

live_scores.name: NFL.com public pages
live_scores.free_tier: Public HTML; no published free developer API for general app use.
live_scores.notes: Official injury report UI at nfl.com/injuries (season/week paths). Scraping is brittle and may conflict with ToS; prefer licensed APIs for production. Official Shield/API paths exist but are partner/OAuth oriented — not a drop-in free public key.

live_scores.name: API-Sports American Football (api-sports.io)
live_scores.free_tier: Same family as API-Football free plan: ~100 requests/day, ~10 req/min; all endpoints; historical seasons limited vs paid. No credit card for free signup (per API-Football/API-Sports public pricing docs).
live_scores.notes: Header x-apisports-key. Covers games, standings, teams, players, injuries, odds-ish endpoints depending on plan. Free quota resets daily (UTC). Good structured alternative to scraping when key is present.

live_scores.name: SportsDataIO NFL API
live_scores.free_tier: Never-expiring Free Trial with selectable leagues/feeds; trial data is SCRAMBLED (integration testing only). Real/live data requires paid production key. Discovery Lab / replay options for historical real data per their developer materials.
live_scores.notes: Auth via ?key= or Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header. Unlimited calls on paid. Excellent for production Survive Sunday once licensed; stub live fields until then.

live_scores.name: The Odds API — scores endpoint (the-odds-api.com)
live_scores.free_tier: Free API key available for signup; quota is credit-based (markets×regions). Scores: 1 credit live/upcoming, 2 if daysFrom set. Note: sibling brand theoddsapi.com (2026 pricing page) lists Free as 25 req/day NBA+MLB h2h only — verify which product/account you use for NFL.
live_scores.notes: Sport key americanfootball_nfl. Live scores ~30s refresh per docs. Prefer for apps already pulling odds from same vendor.

odds.name: The Odds API (the-odds-api.com v4)
odds.free_tier: Free key with monthly credit quota (classic product). Cost = markets × regions per odds call. NFL sport key: americanfootball_nfl. /sports and /events do not consume quota.
odds.notes: Host https://api.the-odds-api.com. Markets: h2h, spreads, totals, outrights; event odds for props on paid-friendly usage. Historical odds paid-plan only. Confirm current free credit allotment on account dashboard — public marketing pages vary between brands.

odds.name: TheOddsAPI (theoddsapi.com) — 2026 published pricing
odds.free_tier: Free $0: 25 requests/day; NBA + MLB only; h2h markets; US books. Professional $29/mo: 20,000 req/mo, 25 sports, h2h+spreads+totals. Business $99/mo: 200,000 req/mo + props/edges/historical. No overage — 429 at limit.
odds.notes: PAID REQUIRED for NFL on this brand's published Free tier (Free excludes NFL). Same key upgrades in place. Distinct from the-odds-api.com docs site — do not assume quotas are identical.

odds.name: API-Sports / API-Football odds endpoints
odds.free_tier: ~100 requests/day free across product family; pre-match / in-play odds endpoints included on free feature set but volume-limited; deeper history on paid.
odds.notes: Useful for prototypes; not a multi-book US DFS powerhouse like dedicated odds aggregators. Watch daily quota.

odds.name: OddsJam Odds API
odds.free_tier: Vendor advertises try-for-free / trial; public page does not publish a durable free production quota. Third-party directories claim freemium numbers — treat as unverified. Expect sales quote for production.
odds.notes: PAID / sales-gated for reliable multi-book real-time feeds (100+ books claimed). Strong for sharp/arb tooling; overkill and paid for Survive Sunday MVP — flag paid_required.

odds.name: SportsDataIO betting / odds feeds
odds.free_tier: Free Trial scrambled data only; live odds feeds are paid commercial products.
odds.notes: PAID for accurate odds. Use trial only to validate response shapes.

recap_videos.name: YouTube — NFL / team official highlights
recap_videos.url_pattern_or_docs: IFrame embed: https://www.youtube.com/embed/{VIDEO_ID} ; Data API: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3 ; quota docs https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/guides/quota_and_compliance_audits
recap_videos.embed_notes: Prefer playlistItems.list / videos.list on known NFL or club channels over search.list (search costs ~100 units). Default Data API quota ~10,000 units/day. IFrame Player API embeds do not spend Data API quota. Use youtube-nocookie.com when privacy mode desired.
recap_videos.terms_caution: NFL game footage and official highlights are copyrighted. Embedding only works when the uploader allows embeds; redistributing or framing full game video outside permitted embeds can violate NFL / YouTube terms. Always keep YouTube branding and link-back; complete compliance audits before requesting quota increases.

recap_videos.name: NFL.com / NFL+ video pages
recap_videos.url_pattern_or_docs: https://www.nfl.com/videos/ ; game center pages on nfl.com
recap_videos.embed_notes: Public highlight pages exist; reliable oEmbed/partner embeds are not a documented free general-purpose API. Deep-link to official pages for MVP rather than hotlinking media files.
recap_videos.terms_caution: NFL Media terms restrict unauthorized scraping/redistribution of video assets. Prefer official share/embed widgets or licensed partners.

recap_videos.name: ESPN watch / highlight pages
recap_videos.url_pattern_or_docs: https://www.espn.com/nfl/ ; related content often surfaces via ESPN web/app (not a stable public embed API)
recap_videos.embed_notes: No supported free developer embed API for ESPN game recaps comparable to YouTube IFrame. Link-out UX is safest for free tier.
recap_videos.terms_caution: Do not scrape or mirror ESPN video streams; commercial use needs licensing.

recommended_stack: Wired in-app (Hobby, no key): ESPN site.web.api scoreboard + injuries JSON (fallback site.api). Odds still seeded. Recaps: YouTube IFrame later. Graduate to SportsDataIO or API-Sports paid when you need SLA. Avoid OddsJam until revenue justifies sales-gated odds.

wired_in_app.live_scores: src/lib/live-scores.ts → ESPN scoreboard; poll ~45s in live window; auto-grade finals
wired_in_app.injuries: src/lib/live-injuries.ts → ESPN injuries JSON; drop Active/cleared; cache ~12 min; never uses sample_injury_news.json in UI

sample_injury_news.json (schema only — UI uses live ESPN; never invent current 2026 status as seed)
recap_videos.*.video_id / embed_url (stub until YouTube API key + channel playlist IDs configured)
player_props / edge / fair_odds (paid OddsJam / Business odds tiers)
SportsDataIO unscrambling (trial data is scrambled — do not show as real)
